notes:
Replication full text verified by title, authors and DOI in body despite incorrectly labeled ResearchGate landing metadata. Figure 2 coefficients are graphical and absent from accessible text parse; no coefficient or numeric p inferred from narrative significance. Original ns label preserved without deriving a numeric bound. Replication 123 is a study sample, not assumed to equal analytic n.
Completion source review (n_o): Directly printed final analysis sample of 805 children selected for less than 5% missing data and imputed; the target is the Figure 4 participant-level fall-to-spring regression. Recruitment/contributor counts 1,242 children and 53 teachers are separate roles.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): All four top-panel cross-lagged regression coefficients have three stars; the legend gives p < .001. This bound is invariant across the four construct-defined paths, so no coefficient-to-arrow assignment from flattened order is needed.
